correctness.rationale: For a nearest-neighbor CT walk with absorption at zero, reflecting endpoint N suppressing attempted outward jumps, and independent rates redrawn each physical tau, the finite killed generator A_N has eigenvalues 1-cos(theta_m), theta_m=(2m+1)pi/(2N+1). Averaging the rate Laplace transform yields G(t)=(I+(t A_N)^alpha)^(-1). Renewal across refresh intervals gives h=(I-G(tau))^(-1)int_0^tau G(t)dt 1=F(A_N)1, with F(s)=tau^(1-alpha)s^(-alpha)+tau int_0^1[(1-u^alpha)/(1+(tau s)^alpha u^alpha)]du. Subordination makes the remainder nonnegative and <=tau alpha/(1+alpha). Eigenvector sine coefficients are exactly 2/(2N+1)sin(j theta_m)cot(theta_m/2). Independently diagonalized actual A_N for N=1,2,3,5,11 against explicit sine eigenpairs, and checked limiting alpha=1 leads to 2jN. The low-frequency singular summation yields finite alpha<1/2, (2sqrt(2tau)j/pi)log N at alpha=1/2, and the stated odd-zeta amplitude N^(2alpha-1) for alpha>1/2. Uniform near-half exponent alpha=1/2+u/logN yields the (exp(2u)-1)/(2u) scaling factor, with bounded physical-time correction. Finite numerics are corroborative only.
